One immutable diagnostic survives GPU initialization failure. Correct zero-count camera diagnosis and collect actual API metadata. Existing video/mask/codec binaries unchanged.
limits: Candidate 3 restores dashboard startup. Wearer reports remaining flicker on hover; read-only logs show HasCamera=true and count zero with successful property call.
Candidate 4 Vulkan import, UI stability, projection alignment and source admission require a wearer test.
Arcturus states direct camera access API is not available. The public API path has not established live Arcturus images on the tested Frame.
No claim of working live scan, automatic detection or game/Venture room adapters.
renderer_tests: Real offscreen Vulkan on lavapipe: 150 changing RGBA uploads and GPU readbacks are byte exact. Five image handles stay stable. The runtime output-device selection callback is exercised; an absent output GPU is refused. Khronos synchronization validation is loaded with no VUID or warning. Unchanged UI does not resubmit; failed texture calls never publish controls. Actual SteamVR texture import and wearer-visible stability remain untested.
startup_tests: Skipped or rejected manifests, optional application API absence and failed identification all preserve dashboard creation. Valid metadata is associated normally.
validation_basis: Inherit exact unchanged transport binaries and their proven source closure; run affected room/native/camera/pipe, real GPU readback/validation, installer, package, PC-only, logging, bootstrap and sanitizer checks. No new native transport/GPU or headset validation claimed.
